structure.unit: Institutions of Higher Education; Other Educational and Cultural Institutions

law.catch_line: Baccalaureate public institutions of higher education; provision of physical evidence recovery kits
law.text:
Each baccalaureate public institution of higher education shall either:
Staff its on-campus student health center with at least one on-campus certified sexual assault forensic examiner, as defined in § 32.1-162.15:2, for the purpose of administering a physical evidence recovery kit, as defined in § 19.2-11.5, to any student who is in need of such a kit; or
Enter into a memorandum of understanding with a local organization or entity that is capable of providing the services of a certified sexual assault forensic examiner, as defined in § 32.1-162.15:2, for the purpose of administering a physical evidence recovery kit, as defined in § 19.2-11.5, to any student who is in need of such a kit.
